'''Jaxor Solusar''' was the son of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Kam Solusar and Fheela, as well as the grandson of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ranik Solusar]]. Jaxor grew up to be very skilled with the Force, displaying a similar aptitude for it as his father and grandfather. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Jaxor was hidden away with his mother and brother, Tev Solusar, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]] under Ranik Solusar's protection. However, Jaxor and his family were discovered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] while his father was off-world; the fledgling [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force user]] was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by Vader alongside his brother, mother and grandfather.

==Behind the scenes==
Set between ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]'' in [[10 ABY]], the cancelled novella ''[[Lightsider (story)|Star Wars: Lightsider]]'' was set to introduce Jaxor as Kam Solusar's long-dead son. However, the unofficially released manuscript of ''Lightsider''<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref> provides a major discrepancy surrounding the time of Jaxor's deaths. Kam Solusar mentions within the manuscript that his family was murdered "thirty-five years ago"<ref name="Lightsider" />, which would would indicate that they died in 25 BBY. However, 25 BBY was six years before Darth Vader began hunting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as part of the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
